title: A proof of Powell's conjecture on the Goeritz group of $S^3$
summary: For a genus $g$ Heegaard splitting of the $3$-sphere, the Goeritz group is defined to be the group of isotopy classes of diffeomorphisms of the $3$-sphere that preserve the splitting setwise. In this paper, we prove the following conjecture proposed by Powell: For every $g \ge 3$, the Goeritz group of a genus $g$ Heegaard splitting is generated by four specific elements. Our proof relies crucially on the fact that a Heegaard surface of the $3$-sphere is topologically minimal, that is, its disk complex has nontrivial homotopy group in some dimension.
